company_overview: Postman is an API platform used for building, testing, managing, documenting, and distributing APIs and services. The platform streamlines collaboration across the API lifecycle while providing enterprise governance, security, and AI capabilities.
target_audience: Engineers and enterprise development teams building, testing, and managing APIs.
leadership: Abhinav Asthana (CEO and co-founder); Ankit Sobti (Co-founder); Abhijit Kane (Co-founder)

company_overview: Supabase provides an open-source Postgres development platform that adds authentication, real-time data, storage, vector embeddings, and APIs to database infrastructure. It enables developers to start applications quickly and scale them to millions of users.
target_audience: Developers and application engineering teams building modern web and mobile applications.
leadership: Tracy Lane (General Counsel); Paul Copplestone; Ant Wilson

company_overview: Vapi provides a developer-first platform designed to build, test, and deploy real-time voice AI agents at scale. The platform handles underlying orchestration, telephony, and infrastructure so businesses can easily configure conversational flow, voice, and third-party integrations.
target_audience: Developers and enterprise engineering teams building, scaling, and managing voice AI agents and inbound/outbound customer support interactions.
